card.name: Reciprocal phrases between two drugs
card.fires_on: Words just before a reciprocal 'each other' or 'the other' when two named drugs or products are the subject, such as 'for', 'effect of', 'inhibit the'.

modes.label: Substitution between two products
modes.description: The word 'for' or 'substituted' after two products that should not replace each other.
